tasks.title: Nmap VNC Scripts
tasks.description: Check the authentication type supported (None, VNC Auth) and whether the server info leaks anything useful.

tasks.title: Try Unauthenticated Access
tasks.description: Misconfigured VNC servers are sometimes left with no password at all -- just connect and see what happens.

tasks.title: Password Brute-Force
tasks.description: VNC's password scheme uses a fixed 8-byte DES key, making offline/online brute-forcing fast. Try common short passwords first.

tasks.title: Decrypt a Stored VNC Password (Config/Registry)
tasks.description: VNC servers (RealVNC, TightVNC, UltraVNC) obfuscate the saved password with a fixed, publicly known DES key rather than hashing it — if you find one in a config file or the registry (HKLM\SOFTWARE\RealVNC\WinVNC4\Password, or ultravnc.ini), decrypt it directly instead of cracking.

tasks.title: Grab a Screenshot Without Full GUI Access
tasks.description: If you just need proof of access or to glance at the desktop, grab a single frame instead of opening a full interactive session.
